notes: SSH sessions are now far more stable: Wingman sends keepalives (like PuTTY), so a long or idle session — e.g. a big image hash during a WLC upgrade — no longer gets dropped by a firewall/VPN with "read ECONNRESET".

Firmware hash checks are now read cleanly: Wingman filters `verify /md5` to its one verdict line instead of drowning in thousands of progress dots, so it reports the match/mismatch the first time instead of re-running.
